subject.title: Feishu plugin: remove dependency on contact:contact.base:readonly for sender name resolution

question: Should basic inbound Feishu message handling be contact-directory-free by default, and what explicit opt-in should govern contact-backed sender lookup and live directory listing?
rationale: This changes organization-directory access, Feishu authorization prompts, sender attribution, documented defaults, and compatibility with an open Feishu display-name PR, so automation should not choose the security boundary.

options.title: Contact-Free Default With Opt-In
options.body: Default basic inbound messages to no contact-directory calls, use verified lower-scope metadata or stable ids, and make contact-backed sender lookup plus live directory listing explicit opt-ins.

options.title: Keep Current Opt-Out Model
options.body: Preserve resolveSenderNames default true and document the sensitive permission tradeoff, accepting the current security and UX friction.

options.title: Land Narrow Display-Name PR First
options.body: Resolve the open Feishu display-name PR first, then keep this issue open for the broader contact-free default and live-directory decision.

recommendation.title: Contact-Free Default With Opt-In
recommendation.body: Default basic inbound messages to no contact-directory calls, use verified lower-scope metadata or stable ids, and make contact-backed sender lookup plus live directory listing explicit opt-ins.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and owns the open overlapping Feishu display-name PR.
